chapter_name: AIAS at the University of Memphis
tagline: Design community. Professional growth. Student leadership.
hero_title: Built by architecture students, for architecture students.
hero_text: A student-led chapter connecting University of Memphis architecture and interior architecture students through events, professional development, design culture, and opportunities beyond the studio.
about_text: The University of Memphis chapter of the American Institute of Architecture Students creates opportunities for students to build community, develop professionally, connect with local practitioners, and take an active role in shaping studio culture.
